sloka: तामेवमुक्त्वा राजन्तीं सीतां साक्षादिव श्रियम् ।आजगाम महावेगो हनुमान् यत्र राघवः ।। ६.११६.५२ ।।
transliteration: tāmevamuktvā rājantīṁ sītāṁ sākṣādiva śriyam ।ājagāma mahāvego hanumān yatra rāghavaḥ ।। 6.116.52 ।।

translations.english: On hearing Mythili, wise Hanuman spoke these words to her bringing joy to her.
